description: This Python source file provides an entry point for subtitle alignment and correction without dependencies on FastAPI. It includes functions to align subtitles with a transcript, correct subtitle text for OTT compliance, and compose SRT formatted text. The main public function 'write_corrected_alignment' takes a transcript and subtitles, performs alignment and correction, and returns the adjusted subtitle list.
